mapper.insert: insert into company_review( review_id, company_id, communication_rate, price_rate, result_rate, schedule_rate, structure_type, area_pyeong, construction_field) values ( #{reviewId}, #{companyId}, #{communicationRate}, #{priceRate}, #{resultRate}, #{scheduleRate}, #{structureType}, #{areaPyeong}, #{constructionField} )

insert into company_score_avg( company_id, company_review_count, sum_communication, sum_price, sum_result, sum_schedule, avg_communication, avg_price, avg_result, avg_schedule, avg_total_rate) values ( #{companyId}, 1, #{communicationRate}, #{priceRate}, #{resultRate}, #{scheduleRate}, #{communicationRate}, #{priceRate}, #{resultRate}, #{scheduleRate}, (#{communicationRate} + #{priceRate} + #{resultRate} + #{scheduleRate} ) / 4.0 )
mapper.select: select company_id AS companyId, avg_communication AS avgCommunication, avg_price AS avgPrice, avg_result AS avgResult, avg_schedule AS avgSchedule, avg_total_rate AS avgTotalRate from company_score_avg where company_id = #{companyId}

select r.review_id AS reviewId, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, c.structure_type AS structureType, c.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, c.construction_field AS constructionField, r.review_img AS reviewImg, r.review_content AS reviewContent, r.review_date AS reviewDate, r.review_modify AS reviewModify from company_review c join review r ON r.review_id = c.review_id join user_detail u ON r.user_id = u.user_id where c.review_id = #{reviewId}

select r.review_id AS reviewId, c.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, c.structure_type AS structureType, r.review_content AS reviewContent from company_review c join review r ON c.review_id = r.review_id where r.target_type = 'INTERIOR' order by r.review_modify desc

select r.review_id AS reviewId, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nickname AS userNickName, c.structure_type AS structureType, c.area_pyeong AS areaPyeong, c.construction_field AS constructionField, review_content AS reviewContent, review_date AS reviewDate, review_modify AS reviewModify from company_review c join review r ON c.review_id = r.review_id join user_detail u ON r.user_id = u.user_id where company_id = #{companyId}
